attributes.label: Connection
attributes.help: Saved Connection profile — it carries the connector type (SFTP, Azure Blob, Kafka, Database).

attributes.label: Dataset
attributes.help: Consume another Pipeline's Dataset: each acquire cycle copies its new parquet snapshots into this pipeline's inbox (the producer's files are never deleted). Dataset entry only — leave blank for file feeds.

attributes.label: Include patterns
attributes.help: Glob/regex discovery patterns; comma-separate multiple. Blank = the pipeline file pattern.

attributes.label: Duplicate detection
attributes.help: File-level duplicate policy — how a re-seen file is recognised.

attributes.label: Recursive depth
attributes.help: Blank = unbounded.

attributes.label: On changed duplicate
attributes.help: What to do when a known file re-appears changed.

attributes.label: Stability window
attributes.help: Wait for a file to stop growing before collecting it.

attributes.label: Archive path
attributes.help: Target directory when "After success" is Move.

attributes.label: Parallel downloads
attributes.help: Remote Collectors only — a local inbox has nothing to download (files are pushed in by the producer). Files this pipeline downloads concurrently in one acquisition, each on its own connector session. Blank = 1 (sequential). The next acquisition starts on the following acquire tick, so fetching stays continuous.

attributes.label: Download rate limit
attributes.help: Remote Collectors only. Cap this pipeline's download bandwidth — a rate like 512KB/s, 10MB/s, or a bare number (bytes/s). Blank = unlimited.

attributes.label: Marker dedup
attributes.help: Skip a file whose marker already exists beside it — the local poll path's re-processing guard.

attributes.label: Marker extension
attributes.help: Suffix of the per-file marker written beside a processed input; a file whose marker exists is skipped.

attributes.label: Marker retention (days)
attributes.help: Stale markers older than this are cleaned up (MarkerManager); blank = the engine default of 90.

attributes.label: Markers directory
attributes.help: Where marker files land (dirs.markers); blank = the space convention.

attributes.label: Unpack compressed inputs
attributes.help: Expand compressed/archived inbox files (.gz/.bz2/.Z/.zip/.tar/.tar.gz) at the collector, before consignments are planned. Blank = on.

attributes.label: Max archive entries
attributes.help: Fail-closed cap on entries one archive may expand to. Blank = 10000.

attributes.label: Max bytes per expanded file
attributes.help: Fail-closed cap on the decompressed size of any single output file. Blank = 8 GiB.

attributes.label: Max bytes per source
attributes.help: Fail-closed cap on total decompressed bytes one source may expand to. Blank = 32 GiB.

attributes.label: Max decompression ratio
attributes.help: Fail-closed output/input ratio cap — the decompression-bomb tell; 0 disables it. Blank = 10000.

attributes.label: Unpack threads
attributes.help: Archives expanded concurrently (one archive per worker). Pure file I/O, but it adds to the same core budget as processing.threads. Blank = 1.

attributes.label: Data extensions
attributes.help: Extensions treated as the DATA suffix for extension-insensitive duplicate identity — cdr.csv.gz, cdr.Z and bare cdr are one logical file. ⚠ Two files differing only by an extension on this list are one logical file too; narrow the list rather than expecting both. Clearing the field reverts to the default; the explicit empty-list opt-out (data_extensions[0]:) is authored in the pipeline file. Blank = .csv .tsv .txt .json .jsonl .ndjson .xml

attributes.label: Run every
attributes.help: This pipeline's own poll cadence — 30s, 5m, 2h, 1d, or a bare number of seconds. Blank = every tick of the space's poll interval. The space poll interval is the resolution floor: a 30s pipeline needs the space tick at 30s or less.

attributes.label: Run on a cron schedule
attributes.help: Calendar cadence in the operations time zone (e.g. daily at 02:00). When both are stated, cron wins over 'Run every'.

attributes.label: Run when
attributes.help: Event trigger: run when the watched source publishes, instead of on a cadence. 'A Dataset is written' pairs naturally with a dataset-entry collector — the write Signal supplies the latency, the acquire cycle does the copy.

attributes.label: Dataset to watch
attributes.help: The Dataset whose writes fire this pipeline — datasets/<id> (a bare id works too). Usually the same Dataset the collector consumes.

attributes.label: Coalesce window
attributes.help: Debounce a burst of writes into one admitted run — 30s, 5m, or a bare number of seconds. Blank = run per write.

label: Parser
description: Reads a landed file into rows; may dispatch by schema/segment (route:*) with an unmatched branch.

label: Map
description: Maps raw fields onto the canonical schema.

label: Dedup (record)
description: Record-grain dedup by business key (QUALIFY); duplicates are a counted reject stream.

attributes.label: Dedup keys
attributes.help: Rows sharing these column values are duplicates; the first (per "Order by") is kept.

attributes.label: Order by
attributes.help: Which duplicate wins — SQL ordering over the typed columns; blank = input order.

label: Filter
description: Keeps/drops rows by predicate; index-anchored CSV row-filter (G1).

attributes.label: Row predicate (after parsing)
attributes.help: SQL over the mapped, typed columns. Rows matching are kept; NULL results are dropped.

attributes.label: Include matching (before parsing)
attributes.help: Keep rows whose target column matches any of these regexes, checked on the raw text before parsing.

attributes.label: Exclude matching (before parsing)
attributes.help: Drop rows whose target column matches any of these regexes.

attributes.label: Include by prefix (before parsing)
attributes.help: Keep rows whose target column starts with any of these.

attributes.label: Exclude by prefix (before parsing)
attributes.help: Drop rows whose target column starts with any of these.

attributes.label: Target column index
attributes.help: Which raw column (0-based) the four before-parsing lists above match against. Ignored by the row predicate.

label: Join
description: Joins against a Reference Dataset by key.

attributes.label: Reference
attributes.help: The registered Reference component joined onto the row set.

attributes.label: Join keys
attributes.help: Column(s) equated between the rows and the Reference.

attributes.label: Group by
attributes.help: Grouping columns of the rollup.

attributes.label: Measures
attributes.help: Aggregate expressions computed per group.

label: Route
description: Content-based routing into operator-defined branches (case / clone).

attributes.label: Route mode
attributes.help: Branch keys, predicates and destinations are edited on the branch rows in the Recipe view.

label: Sink (persistent)
description: Writes the batch to a resting store — a Parquet file / DuckDB table.

attributes.label: Database directory
attributes.help: Directory where committed batches land. The pipeline's primary sink must set this; a quarantine sink writes unmatched files to 'dir' instead.

attributes.label: Output format
attributes.help: Stage-1 output file format; absent = CSV (the engine default).

attributes.label: Compression
attributes.help: Codec for the output (e.g. snappy / zstd / gzip); blank = format default.

attributes.label: Source filename column
attributes.help: Adds a column of this name carrying each row’s source file. New pipelines default to file_name; blank = no column (lineage stays in the ledger only).

attributes.label: Max files per consignment
attributes.help: Pack inbox files into one consignment until this many files. Blank = 1 (each file is its own consignment).

attributes.label: Max bytes per consignment
attributes.help: Or until their summed size would exceed this many bytes. Whichever cap trips first ends the consignment; a single larger file forms a consignment of one.

attributes.label: Consignment order
attributes.help: How inbox files are ordered before packing. Arrival (file time) is the default; name order is the opt-in for feeds whose stamps are unreliable — a copy resets mtime.

attributes.label: Priority
attributes.help: Share weight (1-3) for this pipeline's consignments when execution slots are contended: 3 gets ~3x the throughput share of 1. Shares, never precedence — a priority-1 pipeline always keeps making progress. Blank = 1.

attributes.label: Intake cap (files/cycle)
attributes.help: This pipeline's admission cap, overriding the -Dingest.maxFilesPerCycle global; 0 = explicitly unbounded (exempts this pipeline from a fleet-wide cap). Blank = inherit the global.

attributes.label: Intake cap floor
attributes.help: Floor the adaptive controller may halve this pipeline's cap down to. Blank = inherit -Dingest.minFilesPerCycle.

attributes.label: Adaptive intake control
attributes.help: Whether cycle overrun adjusts this pipeline's cap; off pins it at the stated cap. Blank = inherit -Dingest.backpressure.adaptive.
